text:
maria: quick report + tiny repro: dynamic import of the JS SDK in multiple bundlers can pick the CJS target instead of ESM; reproducible on Windows with Vite HMR and also seen once in a webpack dev server config. repo: https://git.internal/repro/bundler-exports-hmr

jin: steps please?

maria: minimal: clone, yarn, yarn dev, open app, click 'call sdk' which does `await import('redwood-inference')`. Browser error: `Failed to resolve module specifier: "../node_modules/redwood-inference/dist/index.cjs.js"` (Chromium on Win).

oscar: root cause: package.json exports has both "import" and "require". During dev the resolver for dynamic imports sometimes falls back to require target (path normalization/backslashes on Win make Vite/webpack treat it as file resolution). Rollup dev server didn't hit it in my mac test.

maria: I validated three workarounds: 1) optimizeDeps.include the package (vite prebundle), 2) set resolve.conditions = ['import'] in vite, or 3) import explicit ESM path (`redwood-inference/dist/index.mjs`) as a shim. All stop the runtime error but have tradeoffs (HMR differences, TS intellisense oddities).

jin: proposed action: add a DX doc with the repro + three workarounds, mention Windows path normalization and TS d.ts CJS shims. Also ask SDK team to prefer ESM-first exports and ensure published types don't re-export CJS shapes.

bot-ci: created ticket DEVEX-4833 for tracking: "bundler dynamic import may resolve CJS export on Windows — add repro & playbook" :white_check_mark:
